title: LPC to/from Cepstral Coefficients
text: Convert linear prediction coefficients to cepstral coefficients or cepstral coefficients to linear prediction coefficients, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {If first input value is not 1} sets Action to take if first input value is not; {Type of conversion}, {Specify P} sets the method of specifying prediction error power P assume P, {Output P} sets the output prediction error power P, {Output size same as input size} and {Length of output cepstral coefficients vector}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of conversion
params.values: Type of conversion LPCs to cepstral coefficients (default) | Cepstral coefficients to LPCs

params.name: Specify P
params.values: Method of specifying prediction error power P assume P equals 1 (default) | via input port

params.name: Output P
params.values: Output prediction error power P off (default) | on

params.name: Output size same as input size
params.values: Output size same as input size off (default) | on

params.name: Length of output cepstral coefficients vector
params.values: Length of output cepstral coefficients 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: If first input value is not 1
params.values: Action to take if first input value is not 1 Replace it with 1 (default) | Normalize | Normalize and warn | Error
